Class CardPayload

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.shared.payload.servertoclient.game.CardPayload
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class CardPayload extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a snapshot payload of a card (Character, Building, or Event) sent to the client.

This class uses static factory methods to construct specific card sub-types (e.g. hunter, inventor, shaman, builder, event, building) in a single unified payload.
